capabilities: Zoom in to a specific heading or list
Hide everything except the focused section and its content
Zoom out to the entire document via hotkey
Zoom in when clicking on a bullet (configurable)
extras: Free with optional donations (crypto) to the author; includes a debug mode for copying logs via DevTools.
problem: When working inside a long nested list or under a deep heading, the rest of the document clutters the view and distracts from the section being edited.
summary: Editor zoom that hides everything except the current heading or list and its content, with hotkeys to zoom in and out.
